title: hibbertia praestans
intro: Hibbertia praestans, commonly known as Guinea flower, is a small shrub native to the eastern coast of Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in Australian folk medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety and depression, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The Guinea flower's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an anxiolytic and a sedative, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the plant's full range of bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
